package fixture

// RED: a bare Stop inside a goroutine literal. It is still an expression
// statement, and burying it one function literal deep must not hide it -- the
// shutdown path in internal/engine has exactly this shape.

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
)

type proc interface{ Stop(context.Context) error }

func shutdown(p proc, ctx context.Context, wg *sync.WaitGroup) {
	go func() { defer wg.Done(); p.Stop(ctx) }()
}
